messages.author: 9676a88bcd2419b9
messages.subject: DT formatRound
parts:
formatRound in DT is converting NAs to 0.  It is probably using formatC under the covers which does the same.  The functions formatRound and formatPercentage are very convenient...is there an argument which prevents this or can one be added?

==============================
require(dplyr)
require(shiny)
require(DT)


MkDF <- function(nr) { data.frame(value1=runif(nr)) %>% mutate(value2=ifelse(value1>.6,NA,value1), value3=value2) }

server <- function(input, output) {
    ds <- MkDF(15)
    output$tbl = DT::renderDataTable({ DT::datatable(ds, options=list(info=F, searching=F, paging=F)) %>% formatRound("value3",2)  })
}

ui <- shinyUI(
    navbarPage("Example",
        tabPanel("DT", fluidRow( column(offset=2, width=4, DT::dataTableOutput('tbl') ) ) )
    )
)

shinyApp(ui=ui, server=server)
